mapper.select: SELECT r.RECIPE_ID AS recipeId, r.AUTHOR_ID AS authorId, m.NAME AS authorName, m.PROFILE_URL AS authorProfileUrl, r.SOURCE_TYPE AS sourceType, r.EXTERNAL_KEY AS externalKey, r.TITLE AS title, r.SUMMARY AS summary, r.THUMBNAIL_URL AS thumbnailUrl, r.COOK_MINUTES AS cookMinutes, r.DIFFICULTY AS difficulty, r.SERVINGS AS servings, r.STATUS AS status, r.OTHER_INGREDIENT AS otherIngredient, r.PUBLISHED_AT AS publishedAt, r.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, r.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RECIPE_LIKE rl WHERE rl.RECIPE_ID = r.RECIPE_ID) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RECIPE_BOOKMARK rb WHERE rb.RECIPE_ID = r.RECIPE_ID) AS bookmarkCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RECIPE_REVIEW rr WHERE rr.RECIPE_ID = r.RECIPE_ID) AS reviewCount FROM RECIPE r LEFT JOIN MEMBER m ON r.AUTHOR_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE r.RECIPE_ID = #{recipeId} AND r.DELETED_AT IS NULL

SELECT ri.INGREDIENT_ID AS ingredientId, i.INGREDIENT_NAME AS ingredientName, i.INGREDIENT_TYPE AS ingredientType, ri.AMOUNT AS amount, ri.UNIT AS unit, ri.REQUIRED_YN AS requiredYn, ri.SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder, ri.NOTE AS note FROM RECIPE_INGREDIENT ri JOIN INGREDIENT i ON ri.INGREDIENT_ID = i.INGREDIENT_ID WHERE ri.RECIPE_ID = #{recipeId} ORDER BY ri.SORT_ORDER ASC
SELECT STEP_ID AS stepId, STEP_NO AS stepNo, DESCRIPTION AS description, IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl, TIMER_SECONDS AS timerSeconds FROM RECIPE_STEP WHERE RECIPE_ID = #{recipeId} ORDER BY STEP_NO ASC

SELECT c.CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, c.CATEGORY_CODE AS categoryCode, c.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName FROM RECIPE_CATEGORY rc JOIN CATEGORY c ON rc.CATEGORY_ID = c.CATEGORY_ID WHERE rc.RECIPE_ID = #{recipeId} AND c.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT t.TAG_ID AS tagId, t.TAG_NAME AS tagName, t.TAG_GROUP AS tagGroup FROM RECIPE_TAG rt JOIN TAG t ON rt.TAG_ID = t.TAG_ID WHERE rt.RECIPE_ID = #{recipeId} AND t.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT rv.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, rv.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, m.NAME AS reviewerName, m.PROFILE_URL AS reviewerProfileUrl, rv.TITLE AS title, rv.CONTENT AS content, rv.IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl, rv.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM RECIPE_REVIEW rv JOIN MEMBER m ON rv.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE rv.RECIPE_ID = #{recipeId} ORDER BY rv.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT r.RECIPE_ID AS recipeId, r.TITLE AS title, r.THUMBNAIL_URL AS thumbnailUrl,
COUNT(ri.INGREDIENT_ID) AS totalMatchCount,
SUM( CASE WHEN mf.EXPIRES_ON IS NOT NULL AND mf.EXPIRES_ON <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS urgentMatchCount,
( COUNT(ri.INGREDIENT_ID) * 1.0 + SUM( CASE WHEN mf.EXPIRES_ON IS NOT NULL AND mf.EXPIRES_ON <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) * 2.5 ) AS matchScore
FROM RECIPE r JOIN RECIPE_INGREDIENT ri ON r.RECIPE_ID = ri.RECIPE_ID JOIN MEMBER_FRIDGE mf ON ri.INGREDIENT_ID = mf.INGREDIENT_ID AND mf.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} WHERE r.DELETED_AT IS NULL AND (r.STATUS = 0 OR r.STATUS IS NULL) GROUP BY r.RECIPE_ID, r.TITLE, r.THUMBNAIL_URL, r.CREATED_AT ORDER BY matchScore DESC, urgentMatchCount DESC, r.CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS rnum, A.* FROM ( SELECT r.RECIPE_ID AS recipeId, r.AUTHOR_ID AS authorId, m.NAME AS authorName, m.PROFILE_URL AS authorProfileUrl, r.TITLE AS title, r.SUMMARY AS summary, r.THUMBNAIL_URL AS thumbnailUrl, r.COOK_MINUTES AS cookMinutes, r.DIFFICULTY AS difficulty, r.SERVINGS AS servings, r.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, r.STATUS AS status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RECIPE_LIKE rl WHERE rl.RECIPE_ID = r.RECIPE_ID) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RECIPE_BOOKMARK rb WHERE rb.RECIPE_ID = r.RECIPE_ID) AS bookmarkCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RECIPE_REVIEW rr WHERE rr.RECIPE_ID = r.RECIPE_ID) AS reviewCount FROM RECIPE r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.AUTHOR_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE r.AUTHOR_ID = #{memberId} AND r.DELETED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= #{offset} + #{size} ) WHERE rnum > #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RECIPE WHERE AUTHOR_ID = #{memberId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS rnum, A.* FROM ( SELECT r.RECIPE_ID AS recipeId, r.AUTHOR_ID AS authorId, m.NAME AS authorName, m.PROFILE_URL AS authorProfileUrl, r.TITLE AS title, r.SUMMARY AS summary, r.THUMBNAIL_URL AS thumbnailUrl, r.COOK_MINUTES AS cookMinutes, r.DIFFICULTY AS difficulty, r.SERVINGS AS servings, r.STATUS AS status, rb.CREATED_AT AS bookmarkedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RECIPE_LIKE rl WHERE rl.RECIPE_ID = r.RECIPE_ID) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RECIPE_BOOKMARK rb_sub WHERE rb_sub.RECIPE_ID = r.RECIPE_ID) AS bookmarkCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RECIPE_REVIEW rr WHERE rr.RECIPE_ID = r.RECIPE_ID) AS reviewCount FROM RECIPE_BOOKMARK rb JOIN RECIPE r ON rb.RECIPE_ID = r.RECIPE_ID JOIN MEMBER m ON r.AUTHOR_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE rb.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND r.DELETED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY rb.CREATED_AT DESC ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= #{offset} + #{size} ) WHERE rnum > #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RECIPE_BOOKMARK rb JOIN RECIPE r ON rb.RECIPE_ID = r.RECIPE_ID WHERE rb.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND r.DELETED_AT IS NULL
